issues.description: The reference solution for Aufgabe 05 outputs the column 'kreis as avg_flaeche' instead of computing the average area (AVG(flaeche)). This contradicts the task which asks for the average area of municipalities per county (Landkreis) and will mislead students and automated checks.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the incorrect column with an aggregate on the 'flaeche' column. For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis; This returns the average area per Landkreis along with its name and regierungsbezirk, matching the task description.
